units.source_text: “又如：宫廷画院里有许多名画家。

en.t: For example, there are many celebrated painters in the imperial painting academy.

units.source_text: 选出他们的水墨画稿来，一一比较研究，则孰优孰劣，一时实难区别。

en.t: If you selected their ink painting drafts and compared and studied them one by one, it would be very hard at first to tell which were superior and which were inferior.
But there is a principle here:

units.source_text: 画的倘是人目所不曾见过的蓬莱山，或是大海怒涛中的怪鱼的姿态，

en.t: if what is painted is Mount Penglai, which no human eye has ever seen, or the form of some strange fish amid the raging waves of the open sea,

units.source_text: 或是中国深山猛兽的形状，又或是眼所不能见的鬼神的相貌等等，

en.t: or the shape of fierce beasts in the deep mountains of China, or the features of unseen spirits and demons, and the like,

units.source_text: 这些都是荒唐无稽的捏造之物，尽可全凭作者想象画出，

en.t: these are all fantastical inventions without any real basis, so the painter may draw them entirely from imagination,

units.source_text: 但求惊心骇目，不须肖似实物，则观者亦无甚说得。

en.t: and as long as they startle the heart and dazzle the eye, they need not resemble any real thing, so viewers have little to object to.

units.source_text: 但倘画的是世间常见的山容水态、目前的寻常巷陌，

en.t: But if what is painted is the familiar appearance of mountains and waters in this world, or the ordinary lanes and streets before one's eyes,

units.source_text: 附加以熟悉可亲、生动活现的点景；

en.t: with familiar, approachable, vividly lifelike details added as supporting scenery;

units.source_text: 或者是平淡的远山景象，佳木葱茏，峰峦重叠：

en.t: or perhaps a quiet view of distant mountains, with fine trees growing lush and green and peaks rising one behind another:

units.source_text: 前景中还有篱落花卉，巧妙配合。

en.t: with fences and flowers also in the foreground, all skillfully arranged together.

units.source_text: 这等时候，名家之笔自然特别优秀，普通画师就望尘莫及了。

en.t: At such times, the brush of a master naturally shows exceptional excellence, and ordinary painters cannot hope to match it.
